title: A Pennsylvania family bought a 12-acre farm in 1916; 110 years and four generations later...
summary_full: Maple Acres Farm remains Plymouth Township's last working farm, a testament to agricultural heritage.  The McKeown family has preserved thirty acres of land since nineteen sixteen.  This farm now serves as a community market and pick-your-own destination.  It thrives by adapting its business model to suburban surroundings.  Community support and family dedication ensure its continued operation.
